about: Living Résumé settings. Paths are relative to this workspace folder.
projectsRoot_about: Optional. The folder that holds your projects. The scout (Pro) reads case-study-maker build logs (<project>/.case-study/events.json) one or two folders deep.
publish_about: Where `publish --write` copies your files. Example: { "repo": "../my-site" } puts index.html, resume.json and the PDF in my-site/resume/. It never commits.
